tagline: 柯达便携相机，1963 年发布
description: 柯达于1963年推出的便携相机。配备Schneider-Kreuznach Xenar f/2.8 38mm 4-element glass; stopping to f/22。快门速度Compur leaf with speeds 1/30 to 1/500 sec. plus bulb。使用Type 126 film cartridge。

specs.镜头: Schneider-Kreuznach Xenar f/2.8 38mm 4-element glass; stopping to f/22
specs.快门: Compur leaf with speeds 1/30 to 1/500 sec. plus bulb
specs.取景器: Optical viewfinder with bright frame and parallax correction marks
specs.曝光测光: Gossen selenium cell meter with exposure compensation (+/-) indicator in viewfinder
specs.英文简介: The Kodak Typ 048 Instamatic 500 was a manual-exposure viewfinder camera for 126 film cartridges—one of the highest-specification models ever to be offered in the Instamatic range.
